# What it is
LearnThreatOps is a free browser-based SOC analyst training platform.
Users investigate simulated security incidents using SIEM, EDR, and threat intelligence tools.
All 10 investigations are free. No credit card. No setup.

# Who it is for
Cybersecurity freshers, junior SOC analysts, IT professionals transitioning to security,
anyone preparing for a blue team job interview. Primary audience: India and Southeast Asia.

# What makes it unique
100% blue team defensive security. 40% false positive scenarios. Four professional tools per case.
Built specifically for the Indian cybersecurity job market. DPDPA 2023 compliant.
